question: Diwan - i - Arz was essentially the department of ______ under Delhi Sultanate.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Military services**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Some key administrative departments and officials during the period of the Delhi Sultanate, especially under Balban's rule:

 
• **Diwan-i-Arz**: It was the **department of military affairs,** responsible for maintaining the army, assessing taxation for military funding and dealing with all matters related to war and soldiers.
 
• **Diwan-i-Wizarat**: Also known as the **department of finance**, it was in charge of the income and expenditure of the state. It collected revenues and disbursed salaries.
 
• **Diwan-i-Risalat**: This was the **department of foreign affairs**, which dealt with diplomacy and protocol, as well as dispatching ambassadors to foreign states.
 
• **Diwan-i-Insha**: It was a** secretarial department,** responsible for composing royal orders and correspondence.
 
• **Diwan-i-Qaza:** I
